records.title: SQLite database is locked during login/OAuth under concurrent streaming load
bug: encryption-key fingerprint stamp flakes CI on SQLite lock contention
bug: leader lease loss on single-instance SQLite causes a self-sustaining 17-minute `database is locked` stall that blocks leader re-election
bug: wedged-teardown interrupt fails with "Cannot operate on a closed database", then the process holds the SQLite write lock permanently (55 min of database-is-locked while /health stays 200)
fix(dashboard-users): take the owner row before the owned-key cascade reads it
